feature.scope: REPORTED completed assertions; literal clocks/journals/DOM only. The trading window measured on the module, through the entry engine, over HTTP (including the entry-admission path with a completed pre-market routine), across the upgraded committed-M111 release and in the shipped dialog. The sandbox has no market or broker network, so candles are the probes’ own synthetic series and the routine is completed through the app’s own endpoints; no live-feed, provider, broker, pixel, human or production proof is claimed, and nothing here says an hour will be profitable. RAW failures/early aborts, DECLARED assumptions and every frozen milestone-only schema negative remain SEPARATE.

pre_hardening.compare: the policy stage IS the pre-hardening runtime (the delivered rule and the four columns with the committed M111 engine, endpoints and views), asserted identical to pre-hardening-source.json
faults: the module can evaluate a window and the columns can store one, but nothing consults either: setup.js has no veto and no `filters.trading_window`
the engine never merges the state, so the entry-admission path admits what the trader forbade
there is no window endpoint at all: `/api/bots/window` is a 404 and no suggestion can be read or accepted
the settings dialog has no window fields and the bots view has no window line
pre_hardening.why: On the pre-hardening runtime the unchanged probes measured engine 4/14, consumers 7/25, api 7/42 and ui 3/27, and every failing line names the missing enforcement rather than a crash; the same assertions are `ok` on the delivered tree (181/0), and the three fault lines per probe are asserted from both texts above. The staged fault IS the parent’s own committed file.
pre_hardening.parent_measured_inside_the_delivered_pro: The migration probe spawns the parent’s OWN code on the same database: its accounts table has none of the four columns, its own row reads back with the routine settings intact, and the delivered tree afterwards shows exactly the four new NULL columns.

smoke.harness: scripts/smoke-test.js from that same tree, unchanged
smoke.command: PORT=3220 node server.js + node scripts/smoke-test.js http://127.0.0.1:3220
smoke.environment: PORT=3220, TRADEJOURNAL_DB=/tmp/m112-smoke.db (fresh, synthetic), TJ_SCHEDULER=0, TJ_OFFLINE_CANDLES=1, no remote DB
smoke.conditional_view_count: The harness offers its view list conditionally (a chip condition on the content shell), so the reported total moves between samples: it is measured here at the same sample on both trees and the two counts are compared, not asserted absolutely.
smoke.window_dialog_coverage: grep -ci 'trading window' = 0 and grep -ci 'settings' = 2: the smoke run does NOT open the trading-window dialog. M112 ships that dialog in public/js/views/settings.js, and its coverage is analysis/probe-m112-ui.js (30 assertions) — the smoke run is not claimed as dialog coverage.
smoke.limits: jsdom structural/DOM check with no browser engine: no pixel, device, audio, provider, broker, human or production proof, and no mental-state claim.
field_coverage: analysis/probe-m112-ui.js 30/0 — the window dialog, the labelled suggestion and the clear action

trading_window.boundary: half-open [start, end) on the trader’s own IANA clock; a start later than the end wraps midnight on purpose; both sides or neither; an equal pair is refused
trading_window.zone_rule: the account’s owned routine timezone; a window authored in another zone is `unavailable` naming both clocks rather than being reinterpreted

suggestion.band: circular middle 50 % of the trader’s own recorded entry hours, rounded outward
suggestion.recorded_as_history_only_when: the submitted pair is exactly the candidate derived at that moment

enforcement.shape: the state gate’s own merge: breach + status stop + permission {allowed:false, can_override:false, state:’trading_window’}
surfaces: the Now playlist and every scan row

scope: M112 the trading window: a hard block, not a penalty. `src/trading-window.js` owns unset/inside/outside/unavailable with a half-open `[start, end)` on the trader’s own IANA clock, four additive `accounts` columns with the schema’s own CHECKs, a labelled from_session_history suggestion refused below the 30-trade review floor and never applied by the server, and the merge into the desk’s personal state so the entry-admission path, every scan row and `POST /trades` refuse a signal outside it as a veto with `can_override:false` beside the existing non-negotiables. Nothing else moved: no weight, grade, cap, clock, floor, target or risk setting; the weight-8 session/killzone row is untouched; unknown/legacy/imported inputs stay explicitly separate (unset/unavailable/not_consulted) rather than being defaulted into a window. No 70 %/causal/predictive/broker/provider/human/mental-state/pixel/production proof, and no claim that an hour will be profitable.
